name: Logistics & Transport
summary: Fleet visibility, driver accountability and delivery performance across mixed fleets and subcontractors.
problems: Vehicles and drivers tracked in separate systems
Fuel loss with no evidence trail

name: Distribution & Wholesale
summary: Stock accuracy across branches and vans, with orders, deliveries and invoicing on one system.
problems: Stock on the system does not match the warehouse

name: Retail & Multi-Branch
summary: Fast counters, accurate inventory and consolidated reporting across every branch.
problems: Branch stock and pricing drift apart
No single view of group performance

name: Shipping & Freight Forwarding
summary: Quotation to invoice on one record, with documents controlled and margin visible per shipment.
problems: Shipment history spread across email and folders

name: Manufacturing
summary: Production, inventory, procurement and dispatch connected to finance rather than reconciled to it.
problems: Raw material and finished goods tracked separately

name: Cold Chain & Pharma
summary: Temperature integrity evidenced end to end, with exportable compliance records.

name: Construction & Heavy Equipment
summary: Asset utilisation, unauthorised movement and maintenance across sites and plant.
problems: Equipment idle or missing across sites

name: Public Sector & Municipal
summary: Accountable fleet operations with Arabic support and the reporting tenders require.

name: Education & Multi-Campus
summary: Student, teacher, fee, payroll and accounting workflows connected across one institution or an entire campus group.
problems: Student and fee records maintained in separate files
Outstanding balances followed up without reliable ageing
Management reports prepared manually after month-end
